product_metadata.title: Memory Foam Bath Mat for Bathroom Non Slip Bath Rug Velvet Thick Soft and Comfortable Water Absorbent Machine Washable Easier to Dry Floor Rug Mats Waved Pattern, 20x32 Inches, Aqua Green
features: FOOT MASSAGE: These bath mat rug set is crafted from ultra soft coral fleece, fill into innovated memory foam. Backed with non slip rubber bottom, strong and durable. Put your feet out of the shower on these bath runner to give your feet the warm, comfortable home SPA feeling
GREAT ABSORPTION: These cozy plus bath mats/rugs have been used with special technology on quick absorbent and fast drying. Spruce up your powder room for maximum serenity and warmth

ANTI-SLIP: Our 2.0 new version non-skid, no slip, PVC rubber backing is waterproof, perfect use on hardwood floor or floor ties, hassle free for water dampness. Skid-resistant rubber base ensures that the bath mat grips firmly to the floor for safety

STANDARD MEAS: These luxurious bath rugs for bath room/kitchen/entry are constructed with dimensions 32 inches wide x 20 inches long. Features 1 inch of high density and thickness premium memory foam, vary with 13 colors and 2 patterns (striped and waved)

EASY CLEANING: Machine wash separately in cold water using mild detergent. Use only non-chlorine bleach when needed. Also you can simply pick up and shake rug to freshen. Enjoy the ultimate performance bath rugs/mats from Flamingo P USPTO brand
